policy_text: Tata Group entities must not accept uncapped indemnification obligations. Mutual indemnification for direct damages is required.
handling_guidelines: Escalate to Senior Counsel if counterparty demands unilateral or uncapped indemnity.

policy_text: Liability must be strictly capped at 100% of the contract value or fees paid in the preceding 12 months. Exclusion of indirect or consequential damages is mandatory.
handling_guidelines: Reject any clause exposing Tata to unlimited liability.

policy_text: Preferred jurisdiction is Mumbai, India under Indian Law. Alternately, laws of England & Wales or Singapore are acceptable for international agreements.
handling_guidelines: Flag for secondary review if jurisdiction is outside approved regions.

policy_text: Standard NDA obligations apply. Confidentiality period should not exceed 3 years post-termination unless trade secrets are explicitly involved.
handling_guidelines: Ensure survivability clauses align with the 3-year standard limit.

policy_text: Tata Group must retain the right to terminate for convenience with a maximum 30-day notice period. Counterparties cannot lock in multi-year terms without exit clauses.
handling_guidelines: Escalate if counterparty attempts to remove termination for convenience.

policy_text: No implied warranties of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose should be accepted without explicit legal sign-off.
handling_guidelines: Flag any open-ended or 'as-is' warranty disclaimers from counterparties.

policy_text: Standard payment terms are Net 45 or Net 60 days from valid invoice receipt. Late payment penalties must be capped at 1% per month.
handling_guidelines: Auto-approve if terms are Net 45 or greater.

policy_text: Tata Group does not agree to exclusive vendor or supplier lock-in arrangements without C-suite approval.
handling_guidelines: Flag immediately. Exclusivity clauses require Executive VP sign-off.

policy_text: All contracts involving PII must comply with the DPDP Act (India) and GDPR. Vendors must hold ISO 27001 certification.
handling_guidelines: Escalate if data processing clauses lack mandatory breach notification timelines (under 72 hours).

policy_text: All custom deliverables, software, source code, and IP created during the engagement must vest exclusively with Tata Group as a work made for hire. Open-source contamination must be strictly restricted.
handling_guidelines: Escalate to Legal IP Counsel if counterparty claims ownership over custom-built deliverables.

policy_text: Vendors are prohibited from subcontracting any part of their core obligations without prior written consent and clearance from authorized Tata leadership.
handling_guidelines: Flag for review if general, un-restricted subcontracting permissions are requested.

policy_text: Zero tolerance for bribery, kickbacks, facilitation payments, or violations of anti-corruption legislation (e.g., FCPA, Prevention of Corruption Act).
handling_guidelines: Immediate escalation to Compliance Lead if ABAC warranties are missing, modified, or rejected.

policy_text: Tata Group and its designated third-party auditors must have unconditional rights to inspect vendor financial records, security controls, and operational facilities with reasonable notice.
handling_guidelines: Reject any attempt by vendors to restrict, limit, or charge fees for routine compliance audits.

policy_text: Force majeure events must be strictly defined (natural disasters, war, pandemics) with mandatory written notice within 48 hours and active mitigation duties.
handling_guidelines: Auto-approve if standard force majeure conditions and notice windows are met.

policy_text: Vendors must maintain specified minimum monetary thresholds of Professional Liability, Cyber Liability, and Commercial General Insurance throughout the term.
handling_guidelines: Flag if required insurance certificates, cyber liability coverage, or minimum thresholds are omitted.

policy_text: Both parties are restricted from directly or indirectly hiring each other's employees during the contract term and for 1 year post-termination.
handling_guidelines: Auto-approve if standard 1-year non-solicitation window is respected.

policy_text: Upon contract expiration or termination, vendors must provide seamless data handover, knowledge transfer, and operational transition support for up to 90 days.
handling_guidelines: Escalate if vendor attempts to waive transition support or charges exorbitant exit fees.
